_comment: GraphSmith Phase A CI suite manifest (contracts/11, task A-ci-fix B3).
Every tests/<component>/<tester>/run-tests.js suite discovered by the CI
workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml, mirrored in
ci-templates/gitlab-ci.yml) is looked up here by path-prefix to decide
whether it GATES the merge or is EVIDENCE-ONLY (run + logged, never
blocks).
RULE: a per-component REGRESSION suite under tests/<component>/<family>/
for a real GraphSmith component (gate, promote, verify, scenario,
manifest, state-store, loaders, lab, ...) is GATING -- it must stay
green, it is the regression proof for that component. The STANDING
attack batteries under tests/attacks/{constitutional,toctou,
module-escape}/ are also GATING -- they are permanent security
regression tests, not one-shot review artifacts.
Only the ONE-SHOT, NEGATIVE-CONTROL / ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW harnesses --
tests/attacks/{deepseek,gpt-sol-pro}/ and tests/ci/{deepseek,
gpt-sol-pro}/ -- are EVIDENCE-ONLY. Those harnesses exit non-zero BY
DESIGN when they report real findings (that is the whole point of an
adversarial review); gating merge on them would turn CI red on
evidence artifacts even though the component(s) under review are
otherwise TEST-PASSED. Their output is still executed and printed in
full every run -- findings are never hidden -- they just do not flip
the job's exit code.
FAIL-SAFE: a discovered tests/**/run-tests.js suite that appears in
NEITHER list below is treated as GATING and the runner prints an
explicit warning naming it. Unknown suites are never silently
downgraded to evidence-only -- only a suite explicitly listed here as
evidence_only is exempted from gating.
2026-07-25: 13 families were relying on that fail-safe rather than being
listed (adopt, assurance, diagnostics, evalenv, event-compiler, evolve,
graphlint, heal, risk-policy, scaffold, watch, watchdog, watcher). Each
was classified BY IDENTITY against the RULE above, and each of the 13
targets a real GraphSmith component (scripts/adopt.js, assure.js,
diagnostics.js, evalenv.js, event-compiler.js, evolve.js, graphlint.js,
heal.js, risk-policy, scaffold.js, watch.js, watchdog.js, watcher.js), so
all 13 are per-component REGRESSION suites and are now listed as GATING
explicitly. They were already gating via the fail-safe; listing them only
removes 13 warnings and makes the decision reviewable. NONE was moved to
evidence_only: doing so to make the gate green would have un-gated 13
real components. Three of them were genuinely failing and were FIXED (a
POSIX stdout-flush bug in the assurance fixture, and the watchdog's
process-group kill missing non-leader trees); tests/scenario/ was fixed
too. See claude/graphsmith-ci-remediation-progress-2026-07-25.md.
2026-08-07 (v0.5.0 release prep): 4 more families were relying on the
fail-safe -- generate, plugin-hooks, postmortem, reconcile -- covering
the v0.5.0 Wave 1 lanes (scripts/generate.js, the Claude Code plugin/
hooks skill, scripts/postmortem*.js, scripts/reconcile.js). Each is a
per-component regression suite for a real, newly-shipped GraphSmith
component per the RULE above, so all 4 are now listed as GATING
explicitly. All were already passing under the fail-safe (verified via a
full local run of scripts/ci-run-suites.js on this release candidate,
96/96 gating suites green); listing them only removes the 4 discovery
warnings and makes the classification reviewable, it does not change
which suites gate.
2026-08-28 (Track 1.2, standalone gateway): tests/gateway/ is a new per-component
regression suite for the new scripts/gateway/*.js + checks/register-gateway-
sessions.js (Standalone Gateway TRD, SG-FR-1 through SG-FR-5 and SG-FR-7). It is a
real GraphSmith component per the RULE above, so it is listed as GATING explicitly
rather than relying on the fail-safe. Covers mode-selection gating, config schema
validation, session capture/correlation, hash-chain persistence + SG-FR-7's
verifier, proxy dispatch, and a real end-to-end child-process integration test.
